name: Chrome first paint I: the server seeds the account state so the 로그인 link or account frame is in the first painted HTML (R1 F1, account half)
outcome: The chrome's account state is server-seeded (readAuthState in RootLayout → SiteChrome's InitialAccountContext → useAccount's server snapshot, client-only idempotent seed) — the 로그인 link / account frame is in the first painted HTML on 10/10 routes in dev and the production build, 15–60 ms before FCP where it used to land 7–257 ms after; resting layout AE = 0, downstream behaviour unchanged
